title: Concept: Incoming webhook URL with its secret token served in a response
description: A webhook URL authenticates with the URL alone: no header, no signature handled by the application. Serving it therefore grants posting rights into the channel, and the credential stays valid until somebody notices and regenerates it.
applicability: Responses that render configuration, notification settings or an error that includes a request URL.
risk: The caller posts messages as the application, which is usable for phishing inside the workspace and for testing what the team believes about the channel.
